substeps.caption: The chamber door swings open on its left-hand hinge.
A 100 mm build plate goes onto the platform in the build well.
Door shut; the chamber is purged with argon. Drawn see-through from here.
The recoater spreads a layer of powder from the dosing hopper over the plate.
The fibre laser (200 W at launch) melts the layer's cross-section, spot by spot.
The platform drops a layer; the recoater spreads fresh powder over it.
The platform drops a layer; the recoater spreads fresh powder over it.
Three layers drawn, 3 mm each; real ones are 20-60 um. 1000 mm tall, so it stands beside the VLM.
